english.title: Sing / play instrument without permission on Transport for London road transport premises
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) whilst upon Transport for London road transport premises, without the written permission of the operator and to the annoyance of a person,

(A)_[sang]_
(B)_[used an instrument, article or equipment for the production or reproduction of sound, namely **(..SPECIFY..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 7(1) and 14 of the Transport for London Road Transport Premises Byelaws made under paragraph 26 of Schedule 11 to the Greater London Authority Act 1999 and confirmed under section 67 of the Transport Act 1962.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
whilst on Transport for London road transport premises
without written permission and to the annoyance of a passenger
sang/used an instrument/article/equipment for the production/reproduction of sound

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Byelaw 13 for the provision of a name and address by persons suspected of breaching this byelaw.
(ii) See byelaw 15 for a power to remove persons breaching this byelaw
(iii) See byelaw 16 for the requirement for authorised persons exercising any power conferred any of the Byelaws to produce a form of identification when requested to do so.
(iv) See Byelaw 17 in relation to the provision of notices.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant, whilst upon Transport for London road transport premises, without the written permission of the operator and to the annoyance of a person,

(A)_[sang.]_
(B)_[used an instrument, article or equipment for the production or reproduction of sound, namely **(..SPECIFY..).]_

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
